rationale: Links relative paths and runtime resolution; the standalone read defines mode accumulation and failure. Empty-path success explicitly requires the root object to exist. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. readPath checks that the root object exists, returns the effective root reference at epsilon, and traverses intermediate occupied slots; enter joins the carried mode with each stored reference mode. A final slot may be empty. The prose describes this read rather than prescribing one type per object.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
